scope: Authored eight-year extension joining the old enabling envelope with a paid reserve-training pipeline; no entire-country cost/GDP forecast

new_facilities.readiness: Assumed commissioned before year 1; actual sites, procurement and qualification unknown

limits: All intakes, pay, 85% qualification, durations, instructor ratio, prices and dates are authored assumptions, not actual training/qualification evidence. Broad role categories do not certify clinical specialties or real staffing.

All 635 new trainees and 65 instructors are distinct source people with paid time drawn from prior market roles. The 55,000 accounting universe does not prove continued private employment/output or tax receipts.

The old 420-person preparation and its 2/year training line are retained only in their original bounded scope. Actual instructors/qualification for that older programme remain unknown and cannot be certified by this extension.

The proposed candidate model allocates old 108 capital/12 training separately from new 7 training facilities/other inputs. Actual baseline inclusion, overlap and all current 37-function attribution remain unknown, not a second actual bill.

7 training assets are assumed ready and paid at year 0, maintained 0.5/year and gross-replaced 0.35/year. Safe site, equipment, instructor access, energy, water, materials, FX and acceptance remain unverified.

Normal grants/appropriations are assumed upfront only to identify the required envelope. No source, creditor, tax receipt, permission, external counterparty or lawful actual budget is verified; borrowing would add its own service.

Training pay preserves the declared prior wage composition: clinical 209 higher-paid/139 middle-paid, rather than lowering all students to a cheaper uniform wage. Actual hardship and individual source rights need their separate records.

Minimum six-month bridges cover non-qualifiers and instructors after the declared term. They are not guaranteed private jobs, compulsory employment, cancellation of unresolved training claims or all future I05/care/pension costs.

Instruction-loss and unavailable-facility cases change usable admissions/graduates, not the normal spending envelope into a verified revised budget. Unplaced learners retain outstanding commitments; additional completion finance is unknown.

Yearly staffing counts become available only after the complete course; students and instructors are not also frontline capacity. A qualified credential still needs the actual role, shift, safe site and independent acceptance.
A two-year clinical delay is compared through year 10 with two post-completion operating years, retaining other wages/maintenance. A shorter year-8 snapshot cannot hide remaining obligations.

The eight/ten-year finance includes only this joined enabling/reserve programme; baseline public services, household income, all pension/survivor/credit obligations, private finance, existing debt/FX and current country costs are outside and unknown.

The technical opening zero is only the old additional project team, not a claim that an entire country has no other engineers or technicians. Gaps are against a stated postproject target, not proof that all earlier statutory duties were already due.

The known continuing bill excludes baseline capital replacement, future turnover/retirement training, new services, claims and shocks. Post-horizon renewal is unknown, not zero or a stationary workforce.

No assumed AI saving, higher GDP, future tax or birth/migration outcome funds present training or constitutes observed productivity. No real affected participation, independent qualified review or operating readiness was obtained.

The joined candidate attributes old-project wear replacement 5.4/year after commissioning in addition to the old envelope. It must be matched once against the general public replacement budget (29.4 in the older post-commission comparator), not added to that whole budget again. Actual baseline attribution remains unknown.
